pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large sub-polygonal dark regions with curvilinear boundaries. Pixel gradients at the edges are moderately smooth due to resolution limits, showing a soft transition from dark brown to cream. Patches exhibit high spatial area relative to the separating network.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological web of high-luminance pixels forming light corridors. Junction nodes are primarily tri-directional and quadri-directional. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the observed flank and lower neck regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: 1D silhouette of the mane exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile against the background, consistent with short, stiff hair fibers.
